text: Analyse how the extract from The One constructs meaning, including the specific representations
of individuals/groups/events/places, through the following technical elements:
• camera shots, angles, movement and composition
• sound
• mise-en-scène
• editing.
Extract: The One (Episode 1, 2021, dir. Morshead) [25]
Section B: Media contexts
Answer one question from Section B.
You should make references to at least one case study in your answer.
EITHER
Explain the significance of an example of convergence in the media area you have studied. [25]
OR
‘Media consumption is an outdated idea, audiences don’t just “consume” media anymore.’ How far
do you agree with this statement? [25]
